verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's REST API and official MCP server give an agent programmatic access to Klaviyo data (campaigns, flows, audiences) and docs explicitly note pulling data for dashboards/analysis of marketing performance, and connecting an MCP client like Claude to 'get assistance with your Klaviyo data.' However, the evidence pack shows only a campaign-creation endpoint and generic 'pull data' language — no explicit documentation of audience/segment or automation/flow reporting endpoints, or a concrete example of an agent summarizing campaign performance. missing for 10: explicit reporting/analytics endpoint docs, worked example of agent reporting on automation performance, independent confirmation of MCP server pulling live automation/audience data.
